note: exploratory; not in the science record. B2 resamples images as an intervention test, separate from the training pipeline's no-rebin rule. Simplified FERENGI: angular size × D_A(z0)/D_A(z1), flux × (D_L(z0)/D_L(z1))², Gaussian PSF up to the median r-band psfWidth of real test galaxies at z1 (applied to all bands), Gaussian sky noise up to their median per-band sky σ (outer 20-px frame, MAD), centred in a 256-px stamp whose outside is noise only; Planck18. The D_A shrink with the D_L² dimming gives the (1+z)⁴ surface-brightness dimming exactly (D_L = (1+z)² D_A); only the k-correction is missing. The added blur is σ_add² = σ_target² − (s·σ_orig)² − (anti-alias σ after the shrink)², s = D_A(z0)/D_A(z1). Score changes are against the planted (no-change) run; cleaned scores use the simulated nuisances (size × f, magnitude − 2.5 log10 g, target PSF and z, snr = median of real test galaxies near (z, magnitude)). Declared deviation: source specz ≥ 0.01, applied after the size-median cut (z ≤ 0 has no D_A; below 0.01 peculiar velocities make D_A from redshift ≥ 10% off, and the shrink to z = 0.13 leaves < 23 px).
